public.posts: Staging 2026-10-04 08:17 UTC: heap 2.9 MB, indexes 6.8 MB (12). 3.25 MB of that is idx_posts_content_trgm (GIN trigram on content), the only content-search path until P20 names a search engine; it goes when P20 replaces it. Redundant candidates (idx_posts_user_id, a prefix of idx_posts_user_id_created_at; idx_posts_content_hash, 0 scans) are listed for A-4c and stay until the C-2 hold on index drops is reconciled.
